thread:
maya: Quick PSA: someone left a yogurt in the fridge tagged `version: 1..0` and the label keeps changing on its own :eyes:

maya: also the yogurt scribbled a TODO in the margins: `bump to v2 when less tangy`

tom: is this the same yogurt that broke semver last quarter?

jess: please don't encourage it. When dairy gets into dependency management it's a slippery slope :milk_glass:

maya: screenshot (from memory):
```yaml
name: cursed-yogurt
version: 1..0
deps:
  - granola: "0.x"
```

eng-bot: lint-bot: flagged 1 issue in `kitchen/label.yaml` (severity: low) - "Unparseable semver"

oliver: my money's on the YAML cat. It keeps adding stray colons and then naps on the keyboard :cat_nap:

jess: vote: should we rename the fridge to "artifact repository"? react with :fridge: for yes, :shrug: for no

tom: :fridge: (also bringing cookies as peace offering)

maya: added a tiny sticky next to it: "please follow semver or at least ask before mutating"

eng-bot: reminder: CI policy updated - fridge contents are not protected by lockfiles

jess: proposed commit message: "chore(kitchen): educate yogurt on semantic versioning"

oliver: I want a sticker of the YAML cat wearing a tiny semver scarf. fundraising? :money_with_wings:

snack-bot: Lunch reminder: fresh cookies available at 13:00 near onboarding plants :cookie:

maya: if anyone sees a jar labeled `version: major.minor.patch?` please do not open it unless you have admin rights

jess: note to self: add "how to handle sentient condiment semver" to handbook

tom: honestly this is the best kind of bug report. low severity, high morale :tada:
